1. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 因为孟子现在没有朋友，他老是读书：因为孟子现在没有朋友，所以他老是读书，Use “因为……所以……” to make the cause-and-effect relationship explicit.

items.reason: The teacher treats the intended causal relationship as “he has no friends because he always studies,” so adding 所以 reverses the intended cause and result, although the resulting sentence is grammatical.
